import { toPersistenceUser } from '#modules/auth/infra/drizzle/user-mapper'
import { invoices } from './schema/invoices'
import { helper } from '../../helper.js'

export class DrizzleInvoicesRepository {
  async save(invoice: unknown) {
    try {
      await this.db.insert(invoices).values(invoice)
    } catch (error) {
      this.app.log.error({ err: error }, 'insert failed')
      throw error
    }
  }

  async findById(id: string) {
    return this.db.query.invoices.findFirst({ where: helper(id, toPersistenceUser) })
  }
}
